selected_threshold.signal: TPult+8 -> TVagonParam.VSend.Ptm+0 = cars[0]+0, locomotive head TM
selected_threshold.basis: The original native gauge is labelled kgf/cm² and receives raw Ptm without a multiplier. Current Flow.Gauge uses98066.5Pa/unit and native pressure deltas retain that unit. This profile explicitly selects the printed kgf value.

alternative_not_selected.note: The two printed numbers are not exactly equivalent. Exact equipment/revision137+ remains unresolved.

logical_input.one: fixed readiness; retains previous manual memory
logical_input.two: momentary impulse, accepted only on a new1->2 transition
logical_input.native_button: physical idle0 -> logical1; press1 -> logical2; up0 -> logical1
logical_input.source_handover: An already held native button is ignored until released and pressed again.
logical_input.startup: First observed2 is not a new impulse.

memory.set: fresh logical1->2 below or at the selected TM threshold
memory.clear: logical0 or head TM strictly above threshold
memory.held_two: Cannot rearm after TM cancellation until released to1 and pressed again.
memory.priority: KM/KVT execution gates suppress release without erasing manual memory; existing late SAUT/EPK/emergency inhibition remains.

native_patch.restoration: Process memory only; owner/thread/full-producer-byte guards, original code restored before native close.

remaining: Fast native clicks entirely between electrical cycles need a separately verified event queue.
